name: APT packages
description: Installs a list of system packages with apt-get from the repositories the Debian or Ubuntu image already configures.

packages.description: Comma-separated packages to install: name, name=version, or name:architecture. Whitespace around entries and empty entries are ignored; an empty list installs nothing.

installRecommends.description: Include recommended dependencies; installSuggests selects suggested ones.

installSuggests.description: Include suggested packages, independently of installRecommends. APT follows the suggestions of every package it installs, so the installation can grow by orders of magnitude.

refreshPolicy.description: Select native default refresh, check every repository, or require cached metadata without refreshing.

cleanup.description: Remove all managed caches, package files only, or skip feature cleanup. Native retention remains independent.

conffilePolicy.description: What dpkg does, without asking, where a conffile's path holds other content than the package expects: keep the image's file, or replace it with the packaged one.

networkTimeout.description: Native network timeout in seconds (1–3600), or empty to inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.

downloadRetries.description: How often APT retries a failed download after its first attempt (0–10), or empty to inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.

lockTimeout.description: Seconds the installation waits for dpkg's locks (1–3600), or empty to inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.

targetRelease.description: Suite name, codename, or version of a release among the image's sources that APT prefers when installing, or empty to inherit image settings. Adds no source; applies only to this invocation.
